features: 【Upgrade Your Old Stereo】With low latency Bluetooth 5.0 technology, the Aux Bluetooth Adapter wirelessly streams high quality sound from your phone, tablet or PC to any home stereo. With this Bluetooth adapter, you can get rid of cables and enjoy high-quality music wirelessly.

【2 in 1 Bluetooth Transmitter Receiver】Bluetooth Adapter Aux supports audio transmission by both transmitter function (TX) to headphones and receiver function (RX) to car stereo or stereo. The Bluetooth adapter for hifi transmission range is up to 10m (unobstructed).

【Long Playing Time and Easy Setup】Bluetooth receiver for hifi can be used for 10 hours on a single charge (full charge takes only 2 hours). Bluetooth receiver also supports charging while in use. Very easy to set up - just plug in, pair and play.

【Excellent Acoustics】Don't compromise on sound. Easily switch between Bluetooth Transmitter and Bluetooth Receiver modes. Provides a richer and deeper sound experience. You can enjoy high-fidelity sound from a regular audio source.

【Wide Compatibility】Bluetooth Audio Adapter is equipped with two interfaces. All stereo systems with jack or RCA socket are supported. Auto power off after 10 minutes without Bluetooth connection, ideal for home and car audio system.

【Carefree Service】Package: 1x Bluetooth Aux Adapter, 1x USB charging cable, 1x R/L audio cable, 1x 3.5mm audio cable, 1 x user manual (multilingual version). In addition, we offer 12 months warranty and excellent customer service to make your purchase worry-free.

【Note】This Bluetooth Splitter is not recommended for electronic pianos or guitars as these devices require 2.4G transmission for audio synchronisation. Bluetooth devices are not able to meet this requirement because their protocol cannot convert real-time music to electronic music for transmission due to channel size limitations.
